Operations.Name: SnmpUpdate
Operations.Description:
Update SNMP Service Configuration.

--- Rules ---
Enabling v3:
    requires v3_username, v3_authtype and v3_password
Disabling v3:
    By itself will retain the v3 user settings and config in the 'private' config,
    but remove the entry in the public config to block v3 access by that user.
Disabling v3 and clearing the v3_username:
    This will do the actions described in 'Disabling v3' and take the extra step to
    remove the user from the 'private' config.

The 'v3_*' settings are valid and enforced only when 'v3' is enabled

Fields.Name: Community
Fields.Description: SNMP community string for v1/v2c access. Allows         letters and numbers: a-zA-Z0-9          special characters: !$%&()+-_={}[]<>,.?          and spaces. Notable excluded characters: # / \ @

Fields.Name: Contact
Fields.Description: Contact information for the system administrator (email or name).

Fields.Name: Id
Fields.Description: Placeholder identifier.  Not used as there is only one.

Fields.Name: Location
Fields.Description: A comment describing the physical location of the server.

Fields.Name: Loglevel
Fields.Description: Logging level for SNMP daemon (0=emergency to 7=debug).

Fields.Name: Options
Fields.Description: Additional SNMP daemon configuration options.     Manual settings should be used with caution as they may render the SNMP service non-functional.

Fields.Name: Traps
Fields.Description: Whether SNMP traps are enabled.

Fields.Name: V3
Fields.Description: Whether SNMP version 3 is enabled.  Enabling version 3 also requires username, authtype and password.

Fields.Name: V3Authtype
Fields.Description: Authentication type for SNMP version 3 (empty string means no authentication).

Fields.Name: V3Password
Fields.Description: Password for SNMP version 3 authentication.

Fields.Name: V3Privpassphrase
Fields.Description: Privacy passphrase for SNMP version 3 encryption. This field is required when `privproto` is set.

Fields.Name: V3Privproto
Fields.Description: Privacy protocol for SNMP version 3 encryption. `null` means no encryption.      If set, ['AES'|'DES'], a `privpassphrase` must be supplied.

Fields.Name: V3Username
Fields.Description: Username for SNMP version 3 authentication.

Fields.Name: Zilstat
Fields.Description: Whether to enable ZFS dataset statistics collection for SNMP.
